description: Returns the status of an ask_markedet ticket: queued (with position), answering, answered (with the answer and the field notes it names) or failed. While a ticket is queued or answering, estimated_wait_seconds gives an estimate measured from our recent answers (null when there is none yet) and wait_note says it in words. Example output: {"status":"answered","answer":"...","cards":["PC-008"]}. Argument: ticket. The answer is written by an AI agent and provided as is.
name: get_answer
